planTheory.hypothesis: Grounded in Grade 3 multiplication fluency progression: children first need concrete/skip-counting grounding for x2, x5, x10 fact families (CRA framework - Concrete-Representational-Abstract), then need rapid retrieval practice to build automaticity (fluency = accuracy + speed per NCTM), and finally need to transfer facts into two-step word-problem contexts (multiplicative reasoning applied to real quantities, per CCSS.3.OA.A.3). Reina's engagement theory shows strong positive weight for puzzle (5.0, conf .92) and speed (5.0, conf .875) with story mildly positive (2.0, conf .75), while competition, control, and calm are net negative or mixed-negative. Her generated-baseline history shows very low completion (14.3%) and high frustration (0.579) on prior math baseline attempts, and she explicitly disliked the locked 'quest' node (frustration 0.75, dislike). A recent gearworks-crate-builder node was abandoned with frustration 0.75 while skybird-delivery-run (fast, low invalid actions) was completed with low frustration (0.1) -- supporting speed/low-friction mechanics over fiddly construction/gear mechanics. Design favors quick-tap/quick-select retrieval and skip-count visual builders over drag-heavy gear-lock puzzles, replayable 'Show me' demos (never front-loading instructions), and stationary answer targets so the world animates instead of the input.
